Setup backup

Export this project's spaces, widgets, change rules and report templates, and import them into this or another project. Models are matched by name, then discipline.

Models & Forma

Sync schedule

Pull new versions from Forma automatically. With no server behind the site, syncs run while Built Model Pulse is open in a tab; a missed sync runs when you next open it.
